description: Mass-proportional grass split plus modeled downstream stream/product map
source_dataset: Saved BioSTEAM decision reports and Greenhub/results/runs/{run_id}/streams.json; candidate economic overlay
scenario: F1 PR3 AD1 BG2 NR4 A baseline; 56637c072af84ec2bf77e5f24e4299bf; screening CAPEX updated; PEF disabled
units: kg/kg wet grass; dry Nm³/kg wet grass
notes: BioSTEAM process outputs; screening process assumptions. TEA includes partial recorded capital/OPEX, benchmark product prices, subsidy, tax and candidate savings/uplifts. Climate objective is electricity-only attributional burden, excludes heat and substitution credits. Technical ranking gate remains false because storage evidence is unresolved. Financial projections repeat nominal annual accounts for 20 years and are not complete forecasts or balance sheets. Front-end split closes exactly at 1 kg wet grass. Downstream columns show selected actual stream/product quantities, not a closed Sankey: process water, reagents, evaporation and side streams are omitted. Dry normal gas volume uses 273.15 K and 101325 Pa.
